svg.title: Delivery workflow and recovery loop
svg.desc: Six stages: Requirements, UX design (human approval), Code, Pull request (review approvals), Tests, Merge (release decision). Below, the recovery loop: a crash or data issue is detected and diagnosed, a fix is proposed and enters delivery as a pull request, it is reviewed and verified, then the failing request is replayed.
svg.text: crashes and data issues come back through the same reviewed path
fix enters delivery as a PR
